verdict.rationale: Supabase offers both local development (via CLI 'supabase init/start', hands-on verified) and branching environments explicitly designed to test schema/config/feature changes without affecting production, directly matching the sandbox-without-touching-production story. Community evidence corroborates real usage of local dev/migrations, though some report local dev as a weak point (comm-7, comm-8). Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of branching workflow specifically, and no direct evidence addressing data-seeding/isolation guarantees in the sandbox beyond docs claims.
